shots.text: At the end, the six Wardens joined hands around him, the way they had at the beginning of the world.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The six Wardens in a ring around Vael-Orrun, hands joined, their light rising.

shots.text: And Oswin set his lantern in the empty crown.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Oswin stepping into the ring and placing the white lantern into the crown-shaped gap. Light floods the black glass from the inside.

shots.text: For a moment, in the light, he was a man again. Grey, and tired, and much younger than I had imagined.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Inside the light: Vael-Orrun as he was, the kind-faced king in grey, holding his wife's ring. His eyes are not grey. They are only tired.

shots.text:
It was never my voice in the dark. It spoke to me too.

It is still listening.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun looking past the Wardens, past the heroes, at something behind the camera.

shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Thalassa, bells silent in her hair, the only Warden who can meet his eyes.

shots.text:
We did not kill him. I do not think he could be killed. He wanted the middle of the world, so we gave it to him. Not as its king.

As its light.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun cracking apart into pure white light, which rises, and the black sun above the citadel turns gold.

shots.text:
We went home to twenty-six cities of ash. Every one of their people walked back to rebuild them.

That is what we fought for. Not the land. Them.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Montage: Emberfolk relighting the forges of Kethra from their iron pots; Galeborn raising tents at Aurvanis; Sylvaine planting Elowen's seed; Pearlhaven's fleet coming home; Stoneborn unsealing Grundhallow through a door that is part of Orrok; Veilwalkers raising the telescope at Umbrael; Seraphel's glass sword set into the rebuilt Sunstone; Nyxara walking slowly beside Elowen through the ash of Sylvanmere. Tamsin, alive, sitting on the Lantern Walk with Fennick's spectacles, and Oswin, grey and old again, beside her, pointing at the sunset for the Queen.

shots.text:
I am Ysolde, Queen of Solenne. I am old now, and I have never seen a dawn since.

But I have felt every one of them.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde, older, grey hair, still blindfolded, on the walls of a rebuilt Solenne, sun on her face. Credits roll.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: After the credits: the Hall of the Ring, rebuilt, empty, night. The Heartstone glows in six colours... then, faintly, a seventh. Ilyra, alone, leans in to look. Deep inside the seventh colour, something with no colour at all opens, like an eye.

shots.text:
Seven crowns. One door.

Thank you.
shots.speaker: the_hush
shots.art_note: Black. No sound at all for a moment before the voice, and none after. Title card: TO BE CONTINUED.
